name: Postcard Cutout Studio
summary: Turn a folder of travel videos and photos into an editable moving-postcard opener: a cut-out subject over snapping panels, a scrambled title with synced sound, and a photo ending cut to the beat.

compatibility.selects: Tested in a Selects development build (develop, 2026-09-23) on macOS arm64. Requires Panel runScript, managed media generation through the MediaGeneration service (host 2.0.433+), and Draft authoring; on macOS also Panel runShell. On Windows every helper step runs in the Panel through Selects' bundled FFmpeg and FileSystem, and the Draft reads its mask files through FileSystem.pathToLocalURL (host 2.0.508+); not yet run in a Selects Windows build. Every new background removal (Selects generation credits) waits for an explicit confirm in the Panel; a template run only reuses a cutout. Other builds are unverified.

de.name: Postkarten-Freisteller-Studio
de.summary: Macht aus einem Ordner mit Reisevideos und Fotos ein bearbeitbares Intro als bewegte Postkarte: ein freigestelltes Motiv über einrastenden Bildstreifen, ein Titel mit synchronen Soundeffekten und ein Foto-Finale im Takt.

en.name: Postcard Cutout Studio
en.summary: Turn a folder of travel videos and photos into an editable moving-postcard opener: a cut-out subject over snapping panels, a scrambled title with synced sound, and a photo ending cut to the beat.

es.name: Estudio de postales recortadas
es.summary: Convierte una carpeta de vídeos y fotos de viaje en una apertura editable de postal animada: el sujeto recortado sobre paneles que aparecen, un título con efectos de sonido sincronizados y un final de fotos al ritmo.

fr.name: Studio de cartes postales détourées
fr.summary: Transforme un dossier de vidéos et de photos de voyage en ouverture de carte postale animée modifiable : un sujet détouré sur des panneaux qui apparaissent, un titre aux effets sonores synchronisés et un final photo monté sur le rythme.

it.name: Studio cartoline scontornate
it.summary: Trasforma una cartella di video e foto di viaggio in un'apertura modificabile a cartolina animata: il soggetto scontornato su pannelli che compaiono, un titolo con effetti sonori sincronizzati e un finale di foto a tempo.

ja.name: ポストカード・カットアウト・スタジオ
ja.summary: 旅行の動画と写真のフォルダーから、編集できる「動くポストカード」のオープニングを作ります。切り抜いた被写体と次々に現れるパネル、効果音に合わせて揃うタイトル、ビートに合わせて切り替わる写真のエンディングが入ります。

ko.name: 포스트카드 컷아웃 스튜디오
ko.summary: 여행 영상과 사진 폴더로 편집 가능한 움직이는 엽서 오프닝을 만듭니다. 배경을 오려낸 피사체와 차례로 나타나는 패널, 효과음에 맞춰 섞이는 제목, 비트에 맞춰 넘어가는 사진 엔딩이 담깁니다.

pt.name: Estúdio de postais recortados
pt.summary: Transforma uma pasta de vídeos e fotos de viagem numa abertura editável de postal animado: o tema recortado sobre painéis que surgem, um título com efeitos sonoros sincronizados e um final de fotos ao ritmo.

tr.name: Kartpostal Dekupe Stüdyosu
tr.summary: Seyahat videoları ve fotoğraflarından oluşan bir klasörü düzenlenebilir hareketli kartpostal açılışına dönüştürür: beliren panellerin üzerinde dekupe edilmiş özne, senkron ses efektli bir başlık ve ritme göre kesilen fotoğraf finali.

zh.name: 明信片抠像工作室
zh.summary: 把一个文件夹的旅行视频和照片做成可编辑的“动态明信片”片头：抠出的主体叠在依次出现的背景条上，标题随音效滚动定格，结尾照片按节拍切换。

inputs.label: Subject
inputs.hint: The person cut out and placed over the other clips.

inputs.label: Background clips
inputs.hint: One strip each, left to right. Six fills the frame like the preview.

inputs.label: Ending clips
inputs.hint: Cut to the beat at the end.

prepare: A clip of one person (they'll be cut out as the subject)
Clips or photos of places for the background and ending
